title: Process Flowcharts (Mermaid)
note: Real flowcharts (with branches/decisions) for key processes. Rendered via mermaid. Clinical Flowcharts Dashboard — 3 endpoints live (/api/clinical-flowcharts/*), 4-tab frontend UI.

flowcharts.title: Governed EEG Read
flowcharts.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  A[Upload EEG/video-EEG] --> B[Parse + 47 features]
  B --> C[Signal quality + bands]
  C --> D{Quality OK?}
  D -- No --> E[Flag re-record] --> A
  D -- Yes --> F[Model predict seizure-risk]
  F --> G[SHAP explanation]
  G --> H{Neurologist agrees?}
  H -- Override --> I[Record override]
  H -- Confirm --> J[Sign-off]
  I --> K[Audit + report]
  J --> K

flowcharts.title: Council of Agents (governed)
flowcharts.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  Q[Clinical query] --> S{Security guardrail}
  S -- Block --> X[Reject + audit]
  S -- Pass --> P[Planner]
  P --> R[RAG retrieve + generate]
  R --> E[Evaluation]
  E --> RV[Review / consensus]
  RV --> C{Compliance + fairness}
  C -- Fail --> H[Escalate to human]
  C -- Pass --> O[Answer + audit]
  H --> O

flowcharts.title: Multi-Expert Study Review
flowcharts.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  A[AI assessment] --> B[Neurologist review]
  A --> C[EEG Tech review]
  A --> D[Psychiatrist review]
  B --> E{Agree with AI?}
  C --> E
  D --> E
  E -- Disagree --> F[Flag + discuss]
  E -- Agree --> G[Reconciled final]
  F --> G
  G --> H[Audit trail]

flowcharts.title: IoT Device → Alert
flowcharts.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  D[Wearable/Emotiv] --> G[Gateway heartbeat+buffer]
  G --> E[Edge: PII scrub + features]
  E --> M[Edge model inference]
  M --> C{Confidence > threshold?}
  C -- No --> L[Log only]
  C -- Yes --> A[SOS alert + escalation]
  A --> N[Caregiver notified + audit]

flowcharts.title: Patient Onboarding
flowcharts.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  A[Consent] --> B[Demographics + history]
  B --> C[Upload docs]
  C --> D[Extract pdf/image/video/edf]
  D --> E[Build patient master]
  E --> F[Vector ingest]
  F --> G[Ready: any role can query via RAG]

flowcharts.title: Assessment Form Flow
flowcharts.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  A[Expert assigns form] --> B[Patient fills via portal]
  B --> C[Auto-score]
  C --> D{Alert item positive?}
  D -- Yes --> E[Escalate]
  D -- No --> F[Save + interpret band]
  E --> F
  F --> G[Transaction audit]
